description: Functional testing, test case writing and regression testing on hOn, Haier Europe's IoT mobile app, within a large-scale ecosystem of connected devices. Validation of features against Product Owner specifications and acceptance criteria through end-to-end scenarios, and defect reporting in Jira with structured, reproducible reports. Verification and differentiation of bugs between appliance firmware and mobile app software, in collaboration with developers and Product Owners to keep specification and implementation aligned, in a daily English-based workflow.
